reviews.title: Makes Email Marketing Much Easier
reviews.text: What I like most about Klaviyo is how simple it makes email marketing. I use it mainly to build automated flows like welcome emails and abandoned cart reminders, and the visual Flow Builder makes it easy to update everything without much effort. I also rely on customer segments to send different campaigns based on purchase history or engagement instead of emailing everyone the same message. After each campaign, I usually check the reporting dashboard to see what worked and what needs improvement. It has saved me a lot of time and made managing campaigns much easier. The biggest issue I've run into is the pricing. As our contact list grew, the monthly cost increased pretty quickly, so it's something we have to keep an eye on. I also needed some time to get comfortable with the more advanced automation flows because there are a lot of options. The reporting is useful, but I sometimes have to dig through multiple reports to find the metrics I'm looking for. None of these are deal breakers, but I'd like to see simpler reporting and a pricing model that's a little friendlier for growing teams.

label.results_evidence: It has saved me a lot of time and made managing campaigns much easier
label.resonance_evidence: What I like most about Klaviyo is how simple it makes email marketing

I provided over 10 unique pieces of identifying information across multiple emails. Any reasonable support team would have verified my identity with a fraction of that. Instead, they kept coming back asking for more, one item at a time, with 8-hour gaps between replies. The issue is still not resolved. My business has been suffering for days because I cannot access my own account. I will be canceling permanently. If your MFA system can break after one use and your recovery process takes days of bureaucratic back-and-forth, something is seriously wrong.

reviews.title: After 9 Years, This Is How They Treat You
reviews.text: I’ve been a paying Klaviyo customer for 9 years. After the Christmas peak, I forgot to downgrade our plan. Our usage dropped, but we continued to be charged at a much higher tier — even though we didn’t use the additional capacity. I hold my hands up — it was my oversight. But there was no cost to Klaviyo, as we didn’t use the extra service. I explained everything clearly and asked if they’d consider a refund for the unused months. They refunded the current month (which hadn't ended yet), but refused to consider the identical previous months. No discussion. No flexibility. Just a copy-paste policy response and a flat “this decision is final.” Even after nearly a decade as a loyal customer, there was zero goodwill. They charged us for services we didn’t use, and wouldn't make it right — even when it would’ve cost them nothing. I can't see a genuine reason for Klaviyo's decision. They would lose nothing by issuing a refund as the services were not used. As a business owner myself, I would not treat a customer this way. If you’re thinking of using Klaviyo, be aware: once they’ve charged you, that’s where the support ends. You’re on your own.
